request: Add coins to collect in this third-person level. Place three coins named `Coin 1`, `Coin 2` and `Coin 3` at (0, 1, -2), (-3, 1, 1) and (3, 1, 2). When the player comes within 1 m of a coin, the coin disappears and a counter named `coins` (starting at 0) adds 1. Once all three are collected, the `Help` text says `All coins!`. Keep the existing test passing.
